title: Willie the Frog
description: Willie the Frog is a small companion mod that adds a tameable frog who follows you on your adventures. You can befriend Willie using seeds, and once tamed, he’ll help you by lighting up dark areas with a torch, sleeping beside you, and reacting to your act
body:
This mod is the result of LOTS of time in my and MCT's life, and is made possible thanks to players like you. If you would like to show a token of your appreciation for my work, and help support the development of Willie the Frog in the process,[Then consider buying me a coffee!](https://ko-fi.com/sweakysneaker)

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
Mainly spawns in anywhere, use seeds to tame him. if not tamed he will scream at you and run away, he will sleep next to you and will hold a torch to help light the way in the caves.

Hug feature: sneak + rightclick 

torch feature: drop a torch or sneak + rightclick while holding a torch

feeding feature: drop a seed or rightclick him while holding seed

theres also easter eggs as well
